children: , formerly known as Casino, said on Tuesday it had reached an agreement in principle to restructure its debt, as it reported 0.3% organic growth in third-quarter comparable sales, weighed down by lower non-food sales particularly in September.

The restructuring deal includes a €390 million ($438 million) capital increase from majority shareholder France Retail Holdings and will reduce the group's Term Loan B debt to €800 million from €1.4 billion, Plesio said in a statement.
It reported comparable sales of €1.95 billion for the third quarter.
